name: Maria-Costanza Barducci
tagline: Top rated Immigration attorney in New York, New York
about: Maria-Costanza Barducci is the managing partner of Barducci Law Firm PLLC in New York, New York, which she founded in 2015. Her practice focuses on immigration law, visas and green cards, where she represents both individuals and corporations navigating the complexities of U.S. immigration.

With bar admissions in both the United States and Italy, Ms. Barducci offers a rare international perspective, making her particularly skilled at assisting clients with cross-border and multinational matters. She regularly advises investors, businesses and professionals seeking to live and work in the United States.

As a dual-qualified attorney, Ms. Barducci combines her international experience and personal dedication to deliver exceptional results. She has represented clients before U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services and federal courts, and has built a reputation for skillfully handling corporate immigration needs as well as individual petitions for visas and permanent residence. Known for her tenacity and hands-on approach, she guides her clients through each stage of the process, ensuring their interests are protected and their goals achieved.

Ms. Barducci is an active member of several professional organizations, including the New York State Bar Association (NYSBA), the National Italian American Bar Association and the American Bar Association. Within the NYSBA, she serves on the Law Practice Management, Disability Rights and Technology Committees, reflecting her commitment to advancing the profession. She is also a member of the Ordine Degli Avvocati di Genova, further reinforcing her strong ties to the Italian legal community.

Fluent in Italian, English and Spanish, Ms. Barducci brings a multilingual advantage to her practice, enabling her to effectively communicate with and advocate for a diverse client base. She is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York.
